explication: SAM is a private network for AI agents: operators enroll nodes, the control plane verifies identity and issues credentials, and nodes connect through a router to discover and invoke policy-authorized services. Nodes also publish local tools and models, expose MCP and OpenAI-compatible interfaces to agents, and support direct connections or relay. The map preserves control-plane administration, persistence, standalone deployment, and sandboxing. README establishes the product workflow; sampled source supports selected control-plane, inference, console, and sandbox details, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
